guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The only resource-type anomaly on a backend is currencyservice_socket rising from 3 to 5.09 (z=+13.91), and all 5 worst traces show error spans originating in currencyservice (reached via productcatalogservice) and surfacing in frontend, whose error rate jumped from 0.0014 to 4.15. The drops in workload, CPU and latency elsewhere look like downstream effects of failing requests, and the logs contain no lines so they neither confirm nor contradict this.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect currencyservice's open connections and socket usage, then restart or reschedule the currencyservice pod to release leaked or stuck sockets and verify frontend error rate recovers.
